[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Sero''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was making numerous replicas of the [[Null Cannon]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] with the intention of distributing them amongst his pirate forces. Sero attempted to negotiate trading the cannons to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], but a surprise arrival of a back up strike team made him believe that the negotiators had betrayed him. He attacked but was defeated.<ref name="TOR" />
